# Bead of Nourishment (`magic-items:bead-of-nourishment`)
**Category:** [Wondrous Items](../equipment-categories/wondrous-items.md) | **Rarity:** Common | **Attunement:** No

Wondrous Item

This flavorless, gelatinous bead dissolves on your tongue and provides as much nourishment as 1 day of Rations.
